movie_title: Gerund or infinitive? Ask BBC Learning English
introduction: When you use two English verbs together, what form does the second verb take? Should you use a gerun

vocabulary.definition: a verb form ending in -ing that functions as a noun
the base form of a verb with 'to', used in various constructions
vocabulary.example: I like to work out in the morning.

vocabulary.definition: a word that shows the relationship between a noun or pronoun and other words in a sentence
vocabulary.example: I look forward to hearing from you soon.

vocabulary.definition: the noun, pronoun, or noun phrase that performs the action of the main verb
to admit or acknowledge something reluctantly, typically something regarded as a fault or crime
vocabulary.example: Oh, I confess to stealing all the money!

vocabulary.definition: to have a plan, goal, or purpose to do something
vocabulary.example: I intend to be very successful.
